'''''Bounty Hunter Means and Methods: Comparative Psychological Perspectives and Quantifications''''' was a [[Paper/Legends|paper]] [[Author/Legends|written]] by [[Soras Varn]]. It documented the wide variety of personalities and modes of operations used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. It was first published in the proceedings of the [[Institute of Imperial Psychological Studies]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
